name: The real Mailer over SMTP, and the D-day notification send path
outcome: Real SMTP Mailer (stdlib, explicit TLS policy) + render/copy layer, the D-day send as a notify pipeline stage on its own lock behind a new 08:30 KST beat entry, notification_send idempotency table (19 tables), the D7 upsert and D23's subject re-signed to 주주의관제탑 — proven live against a local aiosmtpd sink (reset mail, ① and ② deadline mails, idempotency, off switch, ceiling), no real mail sent
